description: Where Kubernetes reads the termination message of the container from, which is shown when the container exits.

messagePolicy.description: Where the termination message is taken from (`terminationMessagePolicy`): `File` reads only the message file, `FallbackToLogsOnError` uses the end of the container log when the file is empty and the container failed.

messagePath.description: Path of the file the container writes its termination message to (`terminationMessagePath`). Kubernetes uses `/dev/termination-log` when empty.
